landing.title: Build mecha from the runner to the display shelf.
landing.lead: Clip parts with nippers, sand the gate marks, then assemble by the manual. No timer, no score, no parts lost under the desk.

1.d: The runner lands on your workbench.

2.d: Click gates with the nipper until the part is free.

3.d: Rub the gate nubs away with sandpaper.

4.d: Drag parts onto their joints, step by step.

5.d: Color each part, place stickers where you like.

6.d: Set the joints, take a photo, shelve it.

landing.footer: Every mecha design here is original, not an official Gundam or other brand product.

hint.nipper: Click a gate (the small connector) to cut the part off the runner. A part comes free once all its gates are cut.
hint.sand: Hold the mouse on a gate nub and rub back and forth until it is flush.
hint.build: Drag a free part onto the yellow outline.
